traditions.LXX: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ .
traditions.KJV: A Psalm of Asaph .

1.english_reference: Truly God [ is ] good to Israel

traditions.LXX: Ὡς ἀγαθὸς τῷ Ἰσραὴλ ὁ θεός ,
traditions.KJV: Truly God [ is ] good to Israel , [ even ]

1.english_reference: [ even ] to such as are of a clean heart

traditions.LXX: τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ .
traditions.KJV: to such as are of a clean heart .

2.english_reference: But as for me , my feet were almost gone

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִ֗י כִּ֭ מְעַט נטוי רַגְלָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: ἐμοῦ δὲ παρὰ μικρὸν ἐσαλεύθησαν οἱ πόδες ,
traditions.VUL: Mei autem pene moti sunt pedes :
traditions.KJV: But as for me , my feet were almost gone ;

2.english_reference: my steps had well nigh slipped

traditions.LXX: παρ᾽ ὀλίγον ἐξεχύθη τὰ διαβήματά μου .
traditions.KJV: my steps had well nigh slipped .

3.english_reference: For I was envious at the foolish

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐζήλωσα ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀνόμοις ,
traditions.KJV: For I was envious at the foolish , [ when ]

3.english_reference: [ when ] I saw the prosperity of the wicked

traditions.LXX: εἰρήνην ἁμαρτωλῶν θεωρῶν ·
traditions.KJV: I saw the prosperity of the wicked .

4.english_reference: For [ there are ] no bands in their death

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְ מוֹתָ֗ ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀνάνευσις ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Quia non est respéctus morti eórum :
traditions.KJV: For [ there are ] no bands in their death :

traditions.LXX: καὶ στερέωμα ἐν τῇ μάστιγι αὐτῶν ·
traditions.KJV: but their strength [ is ] firm .

5.english_reference: They [ are ] not in trouble [ as other ] men

traditions.LXX: ἐν κόποις ἀνθρώπων οὐκ εἰσίν ,
traditions.KJV: They [ are ] not in trouble [ as other ] men ;

5.english_reference: neither are they plagued like [ other ] men

traditions.LXX: καὶ μετὰ ἀνθρώπων οὐ μαστιγωθήσονται .
traditions.KJV: neither are they plagued like [ other ] men .

6.english_reference: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain

traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἐκράτησεν αὐτοὺς ἡ ὑπερηφανία ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain ;

6.english_reference: violence covereth them [ as ] a garment

traditions.LXX: περιεβάλοντο ἀδικίαν καὶ ἀσέβειαν αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: opérti sunt iniquitáte et impietáte sua .
traditions.KJV: violence covereth them [ as ] a garment .

7.english_reference: Their eyes stand out with fatness

traditions.LXX: ἐξελεύσεται ὡς ἐκ στέατος ἡ ἀδικία αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Pródiit quasi ex ádipe iníquitas eórum :
traditions.KJV: Their eyes stand out with fatness :

7.english_reference: they have more than heart could wish

traditions.LXX: διῆλθον εἰς διάθεσιν καρδίας ·
traditions.KJV: they have more than heart could wish .

8.english_reference: They are corrupt , and speak wickedly [ concerning ] oppression

traditions.WLC: יָמִ֤יקוּ וִ ידַבְּר֣וּ בְ רָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק
traditions.LXX: διενοήθησαν καὶ ἐλάλησαν ἐν πονηρίᾳ ,
traditions.KJV: They are corrupt , and speak wickedly [ concerning ] oppression :

traditions.LXX: ἀδικίαν εἰς τὸ ὕψος ἐλάλησαν ·
traditions.KJV: they speak loftily .

9.english_reference: They set their mouth against the heavens

traditions.LXX: ἔθεντο εἰς οὐρανὸν τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν ,
traditions.KJV: They set their mouth against the heavens ,

9.english_reference: and their tongue walketh through the earth

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ לְשׁוֹנָ֗ ם תִּֽהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν διῆλθεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς .
traditions.VUL: et lingua eórum transívit in terra .
traditions.KJV: and their tongue walketh through the earth .

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֤ן ישיב עַמּ֣ וֹ הֲלֹ֑ם
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἐπιστρέψει ὁ λαός μου ἐνταῦθα ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore his people return hither :

10.english_reference: and waters of a full [ cup ] are wrung out to them

traditions.WLC: וּ מֵ֥י מָ֝לֵ֗א יִמָּ֥צוּ לָֽ מוֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡμέραι πλήρεις εὑρεθήσονται αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: et dies pleni inveniéntur in eis .
traditions.KJV: and waters of a full [ cup ] are wrung out to them .

11.english_reference: And they say , How doth God know ?

traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπαν Πῶς ἔγνω ὁ θεός ?
traditions.KJV: And they say , How doth God know ?

11.english_reference: and is there knowledge in the most High ?

traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰ ἔστιν γνῶσις ἐν τῷ ὑψίστῳ ?
traditions.VUL: et si est sciéntia in excélso ?
traditions.KJV: and is there knowledge in the most High ?

12.english_reference: Behold , these [ are ] the ungodly , who prosper in the world ;

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּה אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְ שַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ ἁμαρτωλοὶ καὶ εὐθηνοῦνται ·
traditions.VUL: Ecce ipsi peccatóres , et abundántes in sǽculo ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , these [ are ] the ungodly , who prosper in the world ;

traditions.LXX: εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατέσχον πλούτου .
traditions.KJV: they increase [ in ] riches .

13.english_reference: Verily I have cleansed my heart [ in ] vain ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα Ἄρα ματαίως ἐδικαίωσα τὴν καρδίαν μου ,
traditions.VUL: Et dixi : Ergo sine causa iustificávi cor meum ,
traditions.KJV: Verily I have cleansed my heart [ in ] vain ,

13.english_reference: and washed my hands in innocency .

traditions.WLC: וָ אֶרְחַ֖ץ בְּ נִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνιψάμην ἐν ἀθῴοις τὰς χεῖράς μου ,
traditions.VUL: et lavi inter innocéntes manus meas :
traditions.KJV: and washed my hands in innocency .

14.english_reference: For all the day long have I been plagued ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֱהִ֣י נָ֭גוּעַ כָּל הַ יּ֑וֹם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγενόμην μεμαστιγωμένος ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ,
traditions.KJV: For all the day long have I been plagued ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ ἔλεγχός μου εἰς τὰς πρωίας .
traditions.KJV: and chastened every morning .

15.english_reference: If I say , I will speak thus ;

traditions.LXX: εἰ ἔλεγον Διηγήσομαι οὕτως ,
traditions.KJV: If I say , I will speak thus ;

15.english_reference: behold , I should offend [ against ] the generation of thy children .

traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ τῇ γενεᾷ τῶν υἱῶν σου ἠσυνθέτηκα .
traditions.KJV: behold , I should offend [ against ] the generation of thy children .

16.english_reference: When I thought to know this ,

traditions.WLC: וָֽ֭ אֲחַשְּׁבָ ה לָ דַ֣עַת זֹ֑את
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑπέλαβον τοῦ γνῶναι ·
traditions.KJV: When I thought to know this ,

16.english_reference: it [ was ] too painful for me ;

traditions.LXX: τοῦτο κόπος ἐναντίον μου ,
traditions.KJV: it [ was ] too painful for me ;

17.english_reference: Until I went into the sanctuary of God ;

traditions.LXX: ἕως εἰσέλθω εἰς τὸ ἁγιαστήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ,
traditions.KJV: Until I went into the sanctuary of God ; [ then ]

traditions.LXX: καὶ συνῶ εἰς τὰ ἔσχατα .
traditions.KJV: understood I their end .

18.english_reference: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places :

traditions.WLC: אַ֣ךְ בַּ֭ חֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁ֣ית לָ֑ מוֹ
traditions.LXX: πλὴν διὰ τὰς δολιότητας ἔθου αὐτοῖς .
traditions.KJV: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places :

18.english_reference: thou castedst them down into destruction .

traditions.KJV: thou castedst them down into destruction .

19.english_reference: How are they [ brought ] into desolation , as in a moment !

traditions.WLC: אֵ֤יךְ הָי֣וּ לְ שַׁמָּ֣ה כְ רָ֑גַע
traditions.LXX: πῶς ἐγένοντο εἰς ἐρήμωσιν ? ἐξάπινα ἐξέλιπον ,
traditions.VUL: Quómodo facti sunt in desolatiónem , súbito defecérunt :
traditions.KJV: How are they [ brought ] into desolation , as in a moment !

19.english_reference: they are utterly consumed with terrors .

traditions.LXX: ἀπώλοντο διὰ τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν .
traditions.KJV: they are utterly consumed with terrors .

20.english_reference: As a dream when [ one ] awaketh ;

traditions.LXX: ὡσεὶ ἐνύπνιον ἐξεγειρομένου ,
traditions.KJV: As a dream when [ one ] awaketh ; [ so ] ,

20.english_reference: [ so ] , O Lord , when thou awakest , thou shalt despise their image .

traditions.WLC: אֲ֝דֹנָ י בָּ עִ֤יר צַלְמָ֬ ם תִּבְזֶֽה
traditions.LXX: κύριε , ἐν τῇ πόλει σου τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτῶν ἐξουδενώσεις .
traditions.VUL: Dómine , in civitáte tua imáginem ipsórum ad níhilum rédiges .
traditions.KJV: O Lord , when thou awakest , thou shalt despise their image .

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ηὐφράνθη ἡ καρδία μου ,
traditions.KJV: Thus my heart was grieved ,

21.english_reference: and I was pricked in my reins

traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ νεφροί μου ἠλλοιώθησαν ·
traditions.KJV: and I was pricked in my reins .

22.english_reference: So foolish [ was ] I , and ignorant

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִי בַ֭עַר וְ לֹ֣א אֵדָ֑ע
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ ἐξουδενωμένος καὶ οὐκ ἔγνων ,
traditions.VUL: et ego ad níhilum redáctus sum , et nescívi .
traditions.KJV: So foolish [ was ] I , and ignorant :

22.english_reference: I was [ as ] a beast before thee

traditions.LXX: κτηνώδης ἐγενόμην παρὰ σοί .
traditions.KJV: I was [ as ] a beast before thee .

23.english_reference: Nevertheless I [ am ] continually with thee :

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ διὰ παντὸς μετὰ σοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Ut iuméntum factus sum apud te : et ego semper tecum .
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless I [ am ] continually with thee :

23.english_reference: thou hast holden [ me ] by my right hand .

traditions.LXX: ἐκράτησας τῆς χειρὸς τῆς δεξιᾶς μου ,
traditions.KJV: thou hast holden [ me ] by my right hand .

24.english_reference: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel

traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ βουλῇ σου ὡδήγησάς με ,
traditions.VUL: Tenuísti manum déxteram meam : et in voluntáte tua deduxísti me ,
traditions.KJV: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel ,

24.english_reference: and afterward receive me [ to ] glory

traditions.LXX: καὶ μετὰ δόξης προσελάβου με .
traditions.KJV: and afterward receive me [ to ] glory .

25.english_reference: Whom have I in heaven [ but thee ] ?

traditions.LXX: τί γὰρ μοι ὑπάρχει ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ?
traditions.VUL: Quid enim mihi est in cælo ?
traditions.KJV: Whom have I in heaven [ but thee ] ?

25.english_reference: and [ there is ] none upon earth [ that ] I desire beside thee

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ עִמְּ ךָ֗ לֹא חָפַ֥צְתִּי בָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρὰ σοῦ τὶ ἠθέλησα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ?
traditions.VUL: et a te quid vólui super terram ?
traditions.KJV: and [ there is ] none upon earth [ that ] I desire beside thee .

26.english_reference: My flesh and my heart faileth

traditions.WLC: כָּלָ֥ה שְׁאֵרִ֗ י וּ לְבָ֫בִ֥ י
traditions.LXX: ἐξέλιπεν ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου ,
traditions.VUL: Defécit caro mea , et cor meum :
traditions.KJV: My flesh and my heart faileth : [ but ]

26.english_reference: [ but ] God [ is ] the strength of my heart

traditions.LXX: ὁ θεὸς τῆς καρδίας μου ,
traditions.KJV: God [ is ] the strength of my heart ,

traditions.WLC: וְ חֶלְקִ֗ י אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְ עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ μερὶς μου ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα .
traditions.VUL: et pars mea Deus in ætérnum .
traditions.KJV: and my portion for ever .

27.english_reference: For , lo , they that are far from thee shall perish

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ μακρύνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ἀπὸ σοῦ ἀπολοῦνται ·
traditions.VUL: Quia ecce , qui elóngant se a te , períbunt :
traditions.KJV: For , lo , they that are far from thee shall perish :

27.english_reference: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee

traditions.LXX: ἐξωλέθρευσας πάντα τὸν πορνεύοντα ἀπὸ σοῦ .
traditions.VUL: perdidísti omnes , qui fornicántur abs te .
traditions.KJV: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee .

28.english_reference: But [ it is ] good for me to draw near to God

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִ֤י קִֽרֲבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים לִ֫ י ט֥וֹב
traditions.LXX: ἐμοὶ δὲ τὸ προσκολλᾶσθαι τῷ κυρίῳ ἀγαθόν ἐστιν ,
traditions.VUL: Mihi autem adhærére Deo bonum est :
traditions.KJV: But [ it is ] good for me to draw near to God :

28.english_reference: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: שַׁתִּ֤י בַּ אדֹנָ֣ י יְהֹוִ֣ה מַחְסִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: τίθεσθαι ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ τὴν ἐλπίδα μου ,
traditions.VUL: pónere in Dómino Deo spem meam :
traditions.KJV: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD ,

28.english_reference: that I may declare all thy works

traditions.LXX: τοὺ ἐξαγγεῖλαι πάσας τὰς αἰνέσεις σου
traditions.KJV: that I may declare all thy works .

traditions.LXX: ἐν ταῖς πύλαις τῆς θυγατρὸς Σιών .
